# NeuromorphicBrainInterface

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
An architecture that maps fMRI-derived neural representations onto spiking neural network layers for direct semantic classification. Enables low-power, event-driven brain decoding suitable for in-network neuromorphic hardware deployment.
